name: Liu Shaorong
profile: Listed by Hurun China (2021) with Ma Yongtao for WINBO-Dongjian (Guangdong Dongjian / 东箭科技, auto components, SZ:300978). Searches confirmed Ma Yongtao as Dongjian's chairman and controlling shareholder, but found no source naming Liu Shaorong (刘少容) or her role.
notes: Could not verify identity; company site dongjian.cc PDFs blocked by WAF. Ma Yongtao is chairman/actual controller of Dongjian per a 2023 company announcement (per search summary). Likely a family co-holder; route via company IR.

name: Fu Shan
current_role: Managing Partner, Vivo Capital; Chairman, VISEN Pharmaceuticals (since 2025)
profile: Former Chinese government official (NDRC, State Economic and Trade Commission, State Council offices) who became Blackstone's Beijing chief representative in 2008 and a Senior Managing Director in its private equity group. Joined Vivo Capital in 2013 as Managing Partner and Co-CEO, later CEO of Greater China; now chairs VISEN Pharmaceuticals and sits on biotech boards.
interesting_fact: In a Nov 2025 interview he said Vivo debated 'people versus assets' for two years and decided to back assets, running NewCos whose job is 'to develop its pipeline as fast and cheaply as possible.'
deep_cut_fact: He holds bachelor's and master's degrees in History from Peking University, an unusual background for a biotech investor.
notes: Before Blackstone he was VP of Beijing Mainstreets Investment Group (per globalcustodian/privateequitywire reports of Blackstone's Beijing office). Also on Esco Lifesciences board since May 2021. Best route: Vivo Capital.

name: Sun Jianhua
current_role: Founder, Chairman and General Manager (executive director), Sino Medical Sciences Technology (赛诺医疗, SSE STAR: 688108)
profile: Peking University-trained biochemist with a US PhD who founded Sino Medical in Tianjin in September 2007; the company makes interventional cardiovascular and neurovascular devices (e.g. drug-eluting stents) and listed on Shanghai's STAR Market in 2019. Re-elected chairman in June 2024; in May 2026 the company filed for a Hong Kong main-board listing.
interesting_fact: Sino Medical filed a Hong Kong main-board listing application on 27 May 2026 (sole sponsor CMB International), seeking a dual listing on top of its 2019 STAR Market debut.
deep_cut_fact: Before returning to China he earned a PhD in molecular biophysics from Florida State University (1992) and was technical director at US firm Terion Industries Inc. (1996-2000).
notes: Aged 64 per May 2026 HK filing coverage. Chairmanship confirmed by June 2024 board announcement (static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2024-06-07/1220288402.PDF). Best route: company IR / board secretary office.

name: Wu Xinli
current_role: Co-founder and largest individual shareholder (10.27% as of 31 Mar 2026), Shenzhen Longli Technology (隆利科技, SZ:300752)
profile: Wu Xinli co-founded Shenzhen Longli Technology in 2007. The company makes LED backlight display modules for phones, cars, industrial and medical displays and has worked on Mini LED since 2016. He shares the Hurun listing with Lv Xiaoxia, the company's legal representative and listed chairman. He is the largest individual shareholder.
interesting_fact: Longli started Mini LED R&D in 2016 and has filed 100+ Mini LED patent applications, including work on Mini LED backlights for VR headsets.
notes: Shareholding from quote.cfi.cn/gdtj/66303/300752.html. Sources conflict on his title: startupintros calls him founder/chairman/president, while 36kr lists Lv Xiaoxia (吕小霞) as chairman. Check the latest Longli annual report. Low public profile.
